sources.title: OmniVoice: Free AI Voice Generator & Voice Cloning
sources.snippet: Generate natural speech in 646 languages with OmniVoice — the world's most multilingual AI voice generator. Clone any voice free. Open source, Apache 2.0.

sources.title: OmniVoice AI Voice Cloning — Free, Zero-Shot, 646 Languages
sources.snippet: Clone any voice in seconds with OmniVoice. Upload a 3-25s audio sample — no training required. Zero-Shot Voice Cloning across 646 languages. Free and open source.

sources.snippet: OmniVoice 🌍 OmniVoice is a state-of-the-art massively multilingual zero-shot text-to-speech (TTS) model supporting over 600 languages. Built on a novel diffusion language model-style architecture, it generates high-quality speech with superior inference speed, supporting voice cloning and voice design.

sources.title: OmniVoice — Free AI Voice Generator & Voice Cloning for 646 Languages
sources.snippet: Try OmniVoice online for free. Clone any voice from a short audio clip. Design new voices from text descriptions. Omni Voice supports 646 languages with zero-shot voice cloning and voice design.
